title: Practice 5: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты за или против ___ (аборты)?
exercises.prompt: Are you for or against abortions?
exercises.why: Prepositions followed by the genitive case — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 60.  ·  «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.
exercises.context: Prepositions followed by the genitive case (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 60)
